properties.family: ASCII text with mixed case letters and digits
properties.boundary: single word, already slug-like but containing uppercase letters
properties.observe: the returned string contains only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, and every alphabetic character is lowercase
properties.falsifies: any uppercase letter, underscore, space, or other disallowed character appears in the result, or the result is not a string

properties.family: single-word and multi-word inputs with separators at the ends
properties.boundary: leading and trailing whitespace or punctuation around otherwise simple words
properties.observe: the returned slug has no leading hyphen, no trailing hyphen, and no repeated hyphen substrings
properties.falsifies: the result begins with '-', ends with '-', or contains '--'

properties.family: two or more distinct words separated by whitespace
properties.boundary: multiple spaces, tabs, or mixed whitespace between words
properties.observe: the output preserves the relative order of the alphanumeric word groups and joins them with hyphens
properties.falsifies: word groups appear out of order, merge incorrectly, or are separated by anything other than single hyphens

properties.family: alphanumeric text with embedded punctuation and symbols
properties.boundary: punctuation between words and punctuation adjacent to letters
properties.observe: punctuation and non-alphanumeric separators do not appear in the output except as hyphens that mark word boundaries
properties.falsifies: any punctuation mark, symbol, or whitespace survives in the slug

properties.observe: calling slugify raises TypeError instead of returning a value
properties.falsifies: the call returns normally or raises a different exception type

properties.family: inputs containing non-ASCII letters and accents
properties.boundary: single accented character and short mixed ASCII/non-ASCII words
properties.observe: the result does not preserve or emit transliterated ASCII stand-ins for the non-ASCII characters
properties.falsifies: a non-ASCII character is converted into an ASCII spelling equivalent rather than being removed or otherwise not transliterated

properties.family: inputs with repeated separator runs between words
properties.boundary: multiple adjacent spaces or mixed punctuation clusters
properties.observe: the slug is stable under repeated calls on the same input and does not introduce extra separator artifacts
properties.falsifies: two calls on the same input produce different strings, or repeated separators create malformed hyphen runs

properties.boundary: short input containing only one alphanumeric token
properties.observe: the result remains a plain string slug and stays within the declared valid slug character set
properties.falsifies: the output contains characters outside `abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-` or is not a string

contract_gaps.text: The contract says non-ASCII characters are not transliterated, but it does not specify the exact output for such characters when the output is also restricted to lowercase ASCII letters, digits, and hyphens.
The failure policy names TypeError and says the observable message should indicate a type error, but it does not define an exact message substring or wording to assert against.
The no-third-party-dependencies rule is not test-visible from the function contract alone and cannot be verified from runtime behavior of slugify.
